slides.statSub: David, Matt and Zack. All three.
slides.say:
A three‑way tie for last after Week 9.
No basement has been this crowded at this point since 2021.

slides.title: Who runs the Beer Mile

cards.name: Zack
cards.ln: The fewest points in the league. The odds' favorite to finish last.

cards.name: Matt
cards.ln: Was 3‑6 at this exact point last year. Hold that thought.

cards.name: David
cards.ln: The two‑time defending champion. The most points scored against anyone.

slides.kicker: Week 10: David vs. Matt. One of them gets to four wins.

slides.title: Twelve teams have been 3‑6 after Week 9
slides.kicker: The one who got in: Matt, last year. At 6‑8. He finished 4th.

slides.title: Last isn't always last

cards.name: Wes, 2021
cards.ln: Dead last after Week 9. Won four of five and climbed out.

cards.name: Tola, 2021
cards.ln: Lost all five after Week 9. Finished last.

cards.name: Dylan, 2024
cards.ln: Zack was alone in last at 2‑7 and escaped. Dylan went 1‑4 the rest of the way. Finished last.

slides.kicker: Twice in five years, last place came from outside the basement.

slides.statSub: Tola, one game up on the basement
slides.say:
Tola was 4‑5 after Week 9 in 2021 too. Then he lost five straight and finished last.
The odds give him 2%. History gives him a precedent.
